items.gist: The passage rejects a graha that causes contraction and denies impurity-based worship, while warning that ritual variation produces hellish outcomes.
The body itself is the only temple, and one should remember one tīrtha/mantra while avoiding other tīrthas.
Knowing this method brings ease, so one should abandon the vidhi-net; the mantra's heart is indispensable, and the mantra-net is likewise abandoned.
After eating, no fault arises for those previously initiated, and the samayas are declared as means to attain knowledge.
If immediate putraka-dīkṣā is not to be performed, the child and teacher are consecrated with Śiva's water-pot, concluding this samaya-dīkṣā.
